title: Providence Residence #5 | KEY.co
description_expanded: Luxury unfolds across multiple levels, each tailored to enhance the living experience. The second-floor dazzles with a lavish living area, a spacious den, and a chef’s kitchen equipped with luxury appliances and a wet bar, ideal for entertaining. The private outdoor living space on this level includes a pool, a cozy fireplace, and a gas grill, creating the perfect setting for relaxation or social gatherings. Ascend the private elevator to discover the tranquility of the upper floors, which include a master suite with a soaking tub and personal studio on the third floor, additional bedrooms, and a versatile lounge space on the fourth floor. Completing this exquisite residence is the rooftop terrace, accessed via a spiral staircase, where covered seating and stunning gulf views await, making it an ideal spot for unforgettable evenings under the stars. Providence Residence redefines modern luxury in a breathtaking new series of five condominium units, each masterfully designed to blend state-of-the-art technology with exceptional comfort. This particular unit stands out as a boutique residence, boasting 5,863 square feet of meticulously crafted space. It features a unique second-floor private pool, a grand fifth-floor rooftop terrace offering panoramic views of the gulf, and a sophisticated interior that sets a new standard for upscale living. From the ground up, every detail is thoughtfully appointed, starting with dedicated covered parking for two vehicles and a private entrance accessible by either elevator or stairwell, ensuring privacy and ease from the moment of arrival.
